description: Use when an agent has a job to get done and does not know which tool or in what order: describe it in plain words and it happens in ONE paid call: picks from 71 capabilities - transcription, translation, documents, images, web, on-chain, domains, IPs, weather, FX - fills their parameters and chains up to 3 steps, feeding each result into the next. Priced per job: the 402 challenge quotes YOUR job before you sign, from $0.02. If nothing fits, nothing is charged. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

auto_plan.description: Optional POST-only automatic planner, mutually exclusive with explicit plans. Fixed charge $0.015 + tool_budget_usdc, at most $0.15 total, with no rebate for unused budget. External delegation additionally requires allow_external:true, external_budget_usdc up to $0.05, external_tools curated IDs and current curation_version from /v1/do/market. Both operator activation and a typed approved catalogue are required. A job's text cannot authorize external calls.

input.description: Optional data the job needs: a URL, an EVM address, a domain, or text.

job.description: The job to do, in plain words. Example: read this page and translate it to Spanish.

market_steps.description: Optional POST-only explicit external plan: 1-3 objects with url and params from a verified catalogue entry. Requires enabled isolated purchasing wallet; no example data is reused. Current execution supports GET entries and explicitly curated POST entries.

max_steps.description: How many tools may be chained, 1 to 3. Default 2.

plan_steps.description: Optional POST-only explicit mixed plan: 1-3 total steps, each {route, params} for a local catalogue tool or {url, params} for an eligible verified market entry. Use exact top-level $previous after the first step to pass text. A plan containing an external URL requires enabled isolated purchasing; local-only plans do not.

name: do
title: Describe the job, get it done: one call over the whole toolbox
